violations.msg: User-facing hot-pluggable Qwiic connector J2 exposes SDA/SCL with no ESD clamps and no recorded waiver (product scope); a cable-borne strike discharges directly into U2 PA11/PA12 and U3 (2 kV HBM) - risks field damage, not first bring-up.

Carried verify item 'SHT4x VDD slew <= 20 V/ms vs AMS1117 startup ramp' was assigned to P3/P4 and is still unclosed: the on-file SHT4x datasheet has no slew spec, and AMS1117 current-limit charging of ~27 uF allows ~40 V/ms worst-case on a fast attach, which could leave the sensor in an undefined state until soft-reset.

DNP intent for the THT headers lives only in a custom 'Variant=DNP' field and the value string - the KiCad-native dnp attribute is absent (in_bom yes), so native BOM/POS exports will emit them as populate lines unless P9's BOM writer filters the custom field.
